dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。本日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm your counselor. It's a pleasure to speak with you today.

dialogue.content: こんばんはよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: はじめに年齢、性別を教えてください。
dialogue.English: To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: ４５才　女性です
dialogue.English: I'm 45 years old, female.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。今日はどんなことをお話したいですか。
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 今年度、子供会の役員になりまして、
dialogue.English: This year, I became an officer for the children's association, and...

dialogue.content: 会長のことが苦手でやりづらいんです
dialogue.English: I find the chairperson difficult, and it's hard to work with her.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それはお悩みですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be troubling for you.

dialogue.content: ぜひお話をお聞きしたいので、もう少し詳しくお話聞かせてもらえますか。
dialogue.English: I'd really like to hear more. Could you tell me a bit more in detail?

dialogue.content: そうなんですせっかく仕事するなら、しかもボランティアみたいなのに、楽しくしたいし…
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right. Since I'm going to do the work anyway—and it's basically volunteer work—I want it to be enjoyable...

dialogue.content: その会長は、自分から会長したいと、
dialogue.English: The thing is, the chairperson volunteered for the position herself,

dialogue.content: ええ。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 言って会長になったのに、メンバーをうまくまとめて進められないんです
dialogue.English: but even though she became the chairperson after saying that, she can't effectively lead the members and move things forward.

dialogue.content: 幼稚園のPTAで会長やってたらしいんですが…
dialogue.English: Apparently, she was the PTA president at her kid's kindergarten...

dialogue.content: そのように思われているのですね。それはやりづらさを感じてしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: That's how you see it. I can understand how that would make it difficult for you to work with her.

dialogue.content: はい、前任から引き継いだノートをみんなに見せてくれたらいいのに、
dialogue.English: Yes, it would be so much better if she would just show everyone the notebook she inherited from the previous person,

dialogue.content: ええ。
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: ひとりで抱え込んで、進みが悪いんです
dialogue.English: but she keeps it all to herself, and we make very slow progress.

dialogue.content: だから、
dialogue.English: So,

dialogue.content: 一回の会合で
dialogue.English: in a single meeting,

dialogue.content: ３時間かけてもあまり進まなくて困ります
dialogue.English: we can spend three hours and not get much done, which is frustrating.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。相談者さんが困ってしまうのも自然なことだと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. It's perfectly natural for you to feel troubled by that.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、それで、
dialogue.English: Right? And so,

dialogue.content: 書記に好んで、
dialogue.English: The person who willingly took on the secretary role,

dialogue.content: なってくれた人が、
引き継いだUSBデータを元に、
ええ。
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: なんとか進んでるんです
dialogue.English: is managing to keep things moving using the data from the inherited USB drive.

dialogue.content: できないなら、会長にならなきゃ
dialogue.English: If she can't do the job, she shouldn't have become the chairperson,

dialogue.content: いいと思いませんか？
dialogue.English: don't you think?

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。それでなんとかって感じなんですね。大切な会議がなかなかうまくいかないとそのように思ってしまうのも無理ないと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: I see. So it feels like things are just barely holding together. When important meetings aren't going well, it's understandable to feel that way.

dialogue.content: そうですよね主婦ってみんな忙しいのに、土曜の午前中がつぶれるんです
dialogue.English: Exactly. All of us are busy homemakers, but our Saturday mornings are wasted on this.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。それは少しむっとしてしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That would be a bit frustrating.

dialogue.content: 相談者さんは、今まで教えてくださった会長さんの様子を目にして普段どのように思っていらっしゃるのでしょうか。
dialogue.English: When you see the chairperson behaving in the ways you've described, what usually goes through your mind?

dialogue.content: 見た目はしっかりしてそうなんですが、…しかも私が自分の思うように動かないと、感じ悪い顔をするんですだから、すごく苦手。
dialogue.English: She looks like she has it all together, but... on top of that, if I don't do things exactly as she wants, she gives me a nasty look. That's why I really can't stand her.

dialogue.content: そのようなことがあったんですね。それは嫌な気持ちになってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: So that's what happened. I can imagine that would make you feel very unpleasant.

dialogue.content: そうなんですあと半年も交流するかと思うと、憂鬱です
dialogue.English: Yes. Thinking I have to interact with her for another six months makes me feel down.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。それはとてもしんどいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very draining for you.

dialogue.content: はい、しんどいです
dialogue.English: Yes, it is draining.

dialogue.content: けっこうネガティブ思考な感じの人ですし…
dialogue.English: She seems to be a rather negative person, too...

dialogue.content: ご相談される前までも、相談者さんは我慢してこれられてあと半年間、しんどさをもったままだと、とてもお疲れになってしまうのではないかなと思います。
dialogue.English: It sounds like you've been putting up with this for a while, even before coming for counseling. If you have to carry this burden for another six months, I imagine you'll become completely exhausted.

dialogue.content: はい、ただでさえ、ソフトボールの朝練、夕練とかあるし、
dialogue.English: Yes, and on top of that, I already have my child's morning and evening softball practices,

dialogue.content: 時間的にもしんどいです
dialogue.English: so it's tough time-wise, as well.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。それはしんどいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That does sound very difficult.

dialogue.content: でもですね、
dialogue.English: But, you know,

dialogue.content: ある夕方、
dialogue.English: one evening,

dialogue.content: ええ。
dialogue.English: Uh-huh.

dialogue.content: 夕練が終わった後、
dialogue.English: after evening practice,

dialogue.content: その会長がグランドのポールの鍵しめ係に、
dialogue.English: the chairperson was in charge of locking the poles at the field,

dialogue.content: なって、私は、
dialogue.English: and I was

dialogue.content: ソフトボールの用具を
dialogue.English: taking the softball equipment

dialogue.content: 車で物置にしまいに行き、
dialogue.English: to the storage shed in my car,

dialogue.content: 分担したんですね、
dialogue.English: so we had split the tasks.

dialogue.content: ええ。そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. Okay.

dialogue.content: 物置に私が着いた時、
dialogue.English: When I got to the shed,

dialogue.content: 会長から電話がきたんです
dialogue.English: I got a call from the chairperson.

dialogue.content: 会長から電話ですか。。。
dialogue.English: A call from the chairperson...

dialogue.content: ポールの鍵が鍵穴にささらないと、
dialogue.English: She said the key for the pole wouldn't go into the keyhole,

dialogue.content: 鍵がかけられないから、来てって、
dialogue.English: and she couldn't lock it, so she asked me to come.

dialogue.content: 言ってきたんです
dialogue.English: That's what she said.

dialogue.content: それで、
dialogue.English: So,

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ええ。
dialogue.English: Uh-huh.

dialogue.content: 見たら、たぶん、油切れで、
dialogue.English: When I looked at it, it was probably just out of oil,

dialogue.content: 私がうちに油を取りに行って、
dialogue.English: so I went home to get some oil,

dialogue.content: 油さしたら、すぐに鍵がかけられたんです
dialogue.English: and once I applied some, I could lock it right away.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですか！？
dialogue.English: Oh, is that what happened!?

dialogue.content: そうなんですそしたら、
dialogue.English: Yes. And then,

dialogue.content: その後、一ヶ月くらいは優しくなってんです
dialogue.English: she was nice to me for about a month after that.

dialogue.content: そのようなことがあったんですね。相談者さんは、そのことをどう思っていらっしゃるのですか。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what happened. What do you think about that?

dialogue.content: いつの間にか元に戻ったので、そういう人なんだなって思いました
dialogue.English: She eventually went back to her old self, so I just thought, "That's just the kind of person she is."

dialogue.content: そうなんですねえ。。元にもどったというのは、また苦手な会長3に戻ったというでしょうか。
dialogue.English: I see... When you say she went back to her old self, do you mean she went back to being the difficult chairperson you mentioned?

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: しかも会長の息子さん、うちの息子と同級生で、
dialogue.English: On top of that, the chairperson's son is in the same grade as my son,

dialogue.content: それは、困りますね。。
dialogue.English: That does make things complicated...

dialogue.content: ええ。
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 二年生の時、お菓子目当てにうちに遊びにきてた時期がありましたし…
dialogue.English: and back in second grade, there was a time he used to come over to our house just for the snacks...

dialogue.content: 門限５時だから、４時５５分に、
dialogue.English: His curfew was 5:00, so at 4:55,

dialogue.content: なったら、教えてくださいって頼んでくるし、
dialogue.English: he'd ask me to let him know when it was time.

dialogue.content: でもそのこと、お母さん（会長）知らないし…
dialogue.English: But his mother (the chairperson) doesn't know about any of that...

dialogue.content: 母子ともに嫌…
dialogue.English: I dislike both mother and son...

dialogue.content: そんなことがあったのですね。それは嫌な気持ちになりますよね。。。
dialogue.English: I see, so that happened. I can understand why that would make you feel uncomfortable...

dialogue.content: ここまでのお話を聞かせていただいて、
dialogue.English: From what you've shared with me so far,

dialogue.content: 会長さんとのやりとりでとてもしんどさを抱えていらっしゃる。また、これからの付き合いについても不安をもっていらっしゃる。といったことでお間違いないでしょうか。
dialogue.English: it seems you're finding your interactions with the chairperson very draining, and you're also feeling anxious about your future dealings with her. Is that correct?

dialogue.content: はいそうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: それでは、本日の相談をとおして、どのようになっていったらよいと考えていらっしゃいますか。
dialogue.English: In that case, through our session today, what outcome would you like to achieve?

dialogue.content: なんとか、不快にならずに、子供会役員を終わらすことですかね…
dialogue.English: I guess, to somehow finish my term as an officer of the children's association without feeling so unpleasant...

dialogue.content: そのようにお考えなんですね。それでは、子ども役員の期間での不快感を少しでも減らしていけるように一緒に考えていきましょうね。
dialogue.English: That's what you're hoping for. Alright then, let's think together about how we can reduce those unpleasant feelings during your term.

dialogue.content: はい、どうしたらいいでしょう？
dialogue.English: Okay, what should I do?

dialogue.content: ええ。そのためにもう少しお話聞かせてくださいね。
dialogue.English: Of course. To help with that, could you tell me a little more?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 役員会で、会長さんに不快感を感じたとき、相談者さんはどうされていますか。
dialogue.English: During the officer's meetings, when you feel a sense of discomfort toward the chairperson, what do you usually do?

dialogue.content: 特に何も…自分なりに、普通に過ごしてます
dialogue.English: Nothing in particular... I just try to act normal, in my own way.

dialogue.content: 自分の意見を、
dialogue.English: If I state my opinion,

dialogue.content: 言っても否定されますし、
dialogue.English: it just gets dismissed,

dialogue.content: あまり発言しなくなりました
dialogue.English: so I've stopped speaking up as much.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。頭ごなしに否定されるとやるせない気持ちになりますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It must feel disheartening to be dismissed out of hand like that.

dialogue.content: そうなんですだから、時間だけが、過ぎます
dialogue.English: Exactly. So the time just passes by.

dialogue.content: ええ。そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm. I see.

dialogue.content: 会長さんとの関係は今後どうされたいですか。
dialogue.English: How would you like your relationship with the chairperson to be going forward?

dialogue.content: もう半年たって、こんなんなので、特に仲良くなりたいとも思いませんが、早く役員終わらせたいです
dialogue.English: It's already been six months and this is how things are, so I don't particularly want to become friends with her. I just want this term to be over as quickly as possible.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。。そのようにおもわれていると、とてもしんどいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see... It must be very draining to feel that way.

dialogue.content: どうしようもないですよね？
dialogue.English: There's nothing I can do about it, is there?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 会長さん自体は、人ですから、変えることは難しいとは思いますが、
dialogue.English: We probably can't change the chairperson herself, as she's another person,

dialogue.content: 役員会で過ごすときのお気持ちを変えていくことは可能ではないかなと私は思いますよ。
dialogue.English: but I do think it might be possible to change how you feel during the officer meetings.

dialogue.content: どういうふうに？
dialogue.English: How so?

dialogue.content: 例えば、今回お話にきてくださったこともその1つかと思います　役員会で感じた不快感をしっかり吐き出すことで、次回はすっきりと参加できることもあるかもしれません。
dialogue.English: For example, coming here to talk today is one way. By fully expressing the unpleasant feelings you experienced at the meetings, you might be able to attend the next one with a clearer mind.

dialogue.content: そうですね！たしかに、吐き出して少しスッキリしました！
dialogue.English: That's true! I definitely feel a bit better after venting!

dialogue.content: それはとても良かったです。ご自身でもやもやとしていた嫌な感情が整理されたのではないかと思いますが、いかがでしょうか。
dialogue.English: I'm very glad to hear that. I imagine you've been able to sort through some of those vague, unpleasant feelings you were having. How does that feel?

dialogue.content: はい！無理に仲良くなろうという気持ちが少しでもあると、
dialogue.English: Yes! If I have even the slightest feeling that I have to force myself to get along with her,

dialogue.content: いちいち不快ですが、
dialogue.English: every little thing feels unpleasant.

dialogue.content: そうではなく、
dialogue.English: But if I don't,

dialogue.content: 割り切って仕事をこなす感覚ならいいかもです！
dialogue.English: and just treat it as a job to get done, that might be better!

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。ご自身でしっかりと割り切ってやっていくとお決めになったことはとても素敵なことだと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. I think it's wonderful that you've decided for yourself to compartmentalize and focus on getting the work done.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます！そう思えたのも相談員さんのおかげですね！
dialogue.English: Thank you! It's thanks to you that I was able to see it that way!

dialogue.content: いえいえ。とんでもございません。相談者さんが、ご自身でだされたお考えですよ。
dialogue.English: Not at all. That's an idea you came up with all on your own.

dialogue.content: これまで役員会をうまくやっていこうと、苦手な会長さんに対して頑張って接してこられた相談者さんなら割り切って役員会に臨むことでよい方向に進んでいくのではないかと思います。
dialogue.English: You've been trying so hard to work with a chairperson you find difficult in order to make the meetings go well. I believe that if you approach the meetings with this new mindset, things will move in a better direction.

dialogue.content: しっかりと整理できるように導いていただけたので！話すって大事だと思いました!
dialogue.English: It's because you guided me so I could organize my thoughts! I realized how important it is to talk things out!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます！
dialogue.English: Thank you so much!

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。これからも頭の整理をしたくなったらぜひいらっしゃってくださいね。
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear that. If you ever want to sort out your thoughts again, please feel free to come back.

dialogue.content: はい！ぜひ、またいつかお願いします!
dialogue.English: Yes! I'd love to come again sometime!

dialogue.content: 他に気になることがなければ、本日は終了とさせていただきますがよろしいでしょうか。
dialogue.English: If there's nothing else on your mind, we can conclude for today. Is that alright with you?

dialogue.content: はい大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.content: はい。それでは本日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: All right. Thank you very much for your time today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Thank you as well!

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました。お疲れ様でした！終了お願いします）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much. Great work today! Please end the session.)

dialogue.content: ロールプレイ終了します。後ほど評価をよろしくお願いいたします。どんな意見でも構いませんので、コメントいただけると幸いです。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Ending the role-play. Please provide an evaluation later. Any feedback would be greatly appreciated. Thank you.

dialogue.content: 了解です！
dialogue.English: Understood!

dialogue.content: （終了ボタンお願いします）
dialogue.English: (Please press the End button.)

dialogue.content: すみません。少し整理していました。
dialogue.English: My apologies. I was just organizing my notes.
